title: The Cap on Points Any One Conditioning Shrink Line May Be Taken On
content:
No single shrink line is taken on more points than the storage account allows. This cap governs conditioning shrink on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## The test applied

Where the points the shrink would be taken on stand above the deep-shrink count of 2.5 points and more than one conditioning charge on the account carries points no shrink line covers, the points are capped at the deep-shrink count.

Where the points stand above the deep-shrink count with one conditioning charge uncovered, or the shrink already taken on the account in the last twelve months stands above the crop-year shrink allowance of 1200 bushels, the points are capped at the standard cap count of 2.0 points.

And otherwise the points are taken as they were read off the account.

## The cases in full

| Points the shrink would be taken on | Conditioning charges carrying points no shrink line covers | Shrink already taken over the last twelve months | Points taken |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| above 2.5 | more than one | any quantity | capped at 2.5 |
| above 2.5 | exactly one | any quantity | capped at 2.0 |
| above 2.5 | none | above 1200 bushels | capped at 2.0 |
| 2.5 or below | any number | above 1200 bushels | capped at 2.0 |
| 2.5 or below | any number | 1200 bushels or below | the points as read off the account |
| above 2.5 | none | 1200 bushels or below | the points as read off the account |

Both counts are read strictly above: points of exactly 2.5 do not stand above the deep-shrink count, and shrink of exactly 1200 bushels over the twelve months does not stand above the crop-year allowance.

Where the cap of 2.0 points applies to a reading already below 2.0, the points stand at the lower figure, the cap being a ceiling rather than a floor.

## Worked caps, on hypothetical accounts

**Points read off the account of 4.1, with two conditioning charges carrying points no shrink line covers.** Above 2.5 and more than one charge uncovered, so the points are capped at 2.5.

**Points read off the account of 4.1, with one conditioning charge uncovered and 400 bushels of shrink over the twelve months.** Above 2.5 with exactly one uncovered, so the points are capped at 2.0.

**Points read off the account of 1.8, with 1650 bushels of shrink already taken over the twelve months.** The crop-year allowance of 1200 bushels has been passed, so the cap of 2.0 applies; 1.8 already stands below it, so 1.8 is taken.

**Points read off the account of 1.8, with 300 bushels of shrink over the twelve months and no charge uncovered.** Neither limb stands, so 1.8 is taken as read.
